definitions.gloss: unloading; unloading cargo from a vehicle
definitions.explanation: The act of removing goods or cargo from a truck, ship, or other transport vehicle. A common logistics and delivery term.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷下|にお}ろし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I helped with unloading the truck.

examples.japanese: {荷下|にお}ろし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do the unloading from the back entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{荷下|にお}ろし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: We don't have enough people because there's a large volume of cargo to unload.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in logistics, delivery, and warehouse contexts. Also appears on signs at commercial buildings indicating unloading zones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷下|にお}ろし⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (unloading work)
- {荷下|にお}ろし⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (unloading area)
- {荷下|にお}ろし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to unload)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{荷積|にづ}み→荷積み：24584_nizumi⟧: loading cargo — the opposite action
- ⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧: carrying in — bringing goods into a building, broader than just unloading from a vehicle
